description: AGENT DELETION -- the rhetorical move where an agentless passive omits the responsible actor (Halliday transitivity / critical discourse analysis: 'Shots were fired.' backgrounds WHO fired them; 'Police fired shots.' does not). domains/media_analysis.py's Python side is PURE ANNOTATION: for every 'passive'-construction reading `read_clause` grounds (write=True only, off the byte-parity path) it writes ONE `PassivePredication{verb, patient, agent, agent_filled}` fact -- unconditionally, whether or not any AgentiveVerb row will ever match it. `agent`/`agent_filled` are a MECHANICAL read of the clause's own marker sequence (the SAME by-phrase-head read `reading_collapse._arg_head` already performs elsewhere), tightly gated to the unambiguous single-clause shape [COP, PPART, BY] -- 'X was V-ed by Y', nothing else in the clause -- because the frozen parity corpus's real Aesop/Grimm prose contains cases where a trailing BY belongs to an EMBEDDED reduced-relative participle ('...occasioned BY its fall...') rather than the clause's own passive predicate; a looser 'BY appears somewhere' gate would misattribute agency there. `AgentiveVerb{verb}` is the scalar-row codebook (the SAME normal form as meaning_inference's SelectionalClassPair -- one row per verb entailing a responsible human/institutional actor: fire/kill/beat/pass/detain/arrest/make/shoot/injure), TEACHABLE via domains.teach.teach(agent, 'AgentiveVerb', {'verb': ...}) with NO code change. The rule below makes the WHOLE decision, in Rust: `mint_agent_deletion` JOINS a PassivePredication to an AgentiveVerb row by Eq(pp.verb, av.verb) -- the graph join that replaces `if verb in AGENTIVE_VERBS` -- gated on Eq(pp.agent_filled, 0.0) (a mechanically-read by-phrase agent is decisive: NO deletion) and deduped by a Not-Exists guard on an existing FramingObservation for the same (verb, patient). Mints a REVISABLE `FramingObservation{device:'agent_deletion', verb, patient, confidence, revisable:1.0, note}` -- the same ReadingBelief-shaped layer (value/confidence/source/revisable) `reading_collapse._record_reading_belief` already uses for the passive/stative collapse. `held_framing_observations` (domains/media_analysis.py) is the mechanical reader that queries these back out -- a pure graph read, no decision. UNSAID ROLE (v1.1.0) -- the SAME shape, generalised from a verb's deleted AGENT to a RELATIONAL NOUN's absent complement: 'right' is always a right TO something, so 'states' rights' (no 'to'-complement anywhere) has a residual the reader can FORMULATE ('a right to what?') without ever trying to FILL it (filling needs the world; asking never does). `RelationalNoun{noun, complement_role, theme, question}` is the codebook (one row per expected complement; a noun with several expected complements, e.g. 'killing'->of/by, is several rows), TEACHABLE the same way AgentiveVerb is. `annotate_relational_noun` (domains/media_analysis.py) writes ONE `NominalMention{noun, role, theme, question, complement_present}` fact per (matched relational-noun mention, expected complement) UNCONDITIONALLY -- `complement_present` is a MECHANICAL read (is the token immediately following the noun equal to the row's own complement_role marker -- the same exact-adjacency discipline the agent_deletion by-phrase read uses, not 'the marker appears somewhere'). `mint_unsaid_role` below is the WHOLE decision: Eq(nm.complement_present, 0.0), deduped by a Not-Exists guard, mints a REVISABLE `UnsaidRole{host, role, theme, question, filled:0.0, revisable:1.0, note}' -- the QUESTION, never an answer. POSIT INTENTIONALITY (v1.2.0) -- given a residual (a FramingObservation agent_deletion OR an UnsaidRole), POSIT whether the omission is STRATEGIC (a euphemism/agency-hiding move doing rhetorical work) or INCIDENTAL, GRADED and DEFEASIBLE, honestly UNDETERMINED when signal is thin. `annotate_intent_signals` (domains/media_analysis.py) writes ONE `IntentSignal{residual_type, residual_ref, verb, host, role, register, relevance_key}` fact per held residual, UNCONDITIONALLY -- `register` is a MECHANICAL read of `register_source.decode_register`'s verdict, gated to its OWN `confident` flag (empty string when the shape evidence is not confident, e.g. a bare single-clause residual with too few words -- honest absence, never a guessed register); `relevance_key` is a MECHANICAL structural key built from the residual's own fields ('verb:<verb>' for agent_deletion, 'role:<host>:<role>' for unsaid_role) -- no lookup, no weight, just the join key. `StrategicRegister{register, strategic_weight}` (register/source signal) and `RelevanceWeight{key, relevance_weight}` (Gricean-relevance signal: HIGH for the AGENT of an agentive verb, or a relational noun's DEFINING complement; LOW for a routinely-omitted role) are the TWO teachable codebooks the three rules below JOIN against by Eq(is.register, sr.register) / Eq(is.relevance_key, rw.key) -- the SAME graph-join idiom `mint_agent_deletion`/`mint_unsaid_role` use, generalised to a numeric combine. `ensure_media_analysis_seed` additively registers ONE new register, `official_statement` (an impersonal/no-contraction/no-reference-marker institutional shape -- the register euphemism is written in), into `register_source`'s OWN dynamic codebook via its documented `add_register('added by hint')` extension path (register_source.py itself is untouched; this mirrors that module's own test-suite 'legalese' precedent) -- so the STRATEGIC signal is a REAL, non-fabricated ShapeDecode verdict, never a Python register table. The combine + the THREE-WAY posit decision live entirely in the rules: `mint_intent_attribution_strategic`/`_incidental`/`_undetermined` each Gte/Lte/Gt+Lt-gate `Plus(sr.strategic_weight, rw.relevance_weight)` against the SAME two thresholds (0.7 strategic, 0.15 incidental) and mint a REVISABLE `IntentAttribution{residual_ref, residual_type, posit, confidence, register, register_weight, relevance_weight, source_weight:0.0, basis, revisable:1.0, note}` -- `posit`/`basis` are Lit values on the matching rule, never a Python if/else over a computed number. SOURCE (family 3) is explicitly GATED (`source_weight` is a Lit 0.0 on every rule, `basis` says so) -- `domains/source_provenance.py` requires an explicit `source` label a bare clause residual does not carry, so wiring it here would be fabrication; the two-signal (register+relevance) combine is the honest first posit. `held_intent_attributions` (domains/media_analysis.py) is the mechanical reader.

microtheory.name: media_analysis
microtheory.description: an agentless passive over a held AGENTIVE verb, with no by-phrase agent mechanically found, is rhetorical agent deletion; a relational noun with no adjacent expected complement is an UNSAID ROLE -- both revisable, graph-joined judgments, never a Python membership test

attrs.note: 'Shots were fired.' -- firing entails a responsible agent (a shooter).
'A civilian was killed.' -- killing entails a responsible agent.
beating entails a responsible agent (the beater).
'The bill was passed.' -- passing legislation entails a responsible voting body.
detention entails a responsible authority (who detained).
arrest entails a responsible authority (who arrested).
manufacture/creation entails a responsible maker.
shooting entails a responsible agent (a shooter).
injuring entails a responsible agent (who caused the injury).

attrs.question: a right to what?
attrs.note: a right is always a right TO something -- the object slot is a valency, not decoration.

attrs.question: the killing of whom?
attrs.note: a killing is always a killing OF someone -- the patient slot.

attrs.question: killed by whom?
attrs.note: a killing entails a killer -- the agent slot, mirroring agent-deletion at the nominal grain.

attrs.question: reform of what?
attrs.note: reform is always reform OF some domain.

attrs.question: cuts to what?
attrs.note: cuts are always cuts TO some budget/programme.

attrs.question: growth of what?
attrs.note: growth is always growth OF some measured thing.

attrs.question: growth in what?
attrs.note: the alternate 'growth IN some domain' complement realisation.

attrs.question: casualties among whom?
attrs.note: casualties are always casualties AMONG some group.

attrs.question: a ban on what?
attrs.note: a ban is always a ban ON something.

attrs.question: the death of whom?
attrs.note: a death is always the death OF someone.

no confident register signal (decode_by_shape/decode_register was not CONFIDENT for this clause's text -- typically too short; see _MIN_CONFIDENT_WORDS) -- register contributes NOTHING to the combine, honestly, rather than guessing.
a wikipedia-shaped entry is a neutral tertiary reference source -- LOW strategic prior.
generic encyclopedic/reference prose -- LOW strategic prior.
a story -- LOW strategic prior (fiction is not deploying euphemism to manage a real-world audience).
conversational aside -- LOW strategic prior.
a structural code block -- not a register that frames anything rhetorically.
the live chat-turn aperture register -- LOW strategic prior.

an impersonal, no-contraction, no-reference-marker institutional register (a press release / official announcement shape: domains/media_analysis.py:ensure_media_analysis_seed installs it into register_source's codebook via the SAME add_register('added by hint') extension path the register_source test suite's own 'legalese' precedent uses) -- HIGH strategic prior: institutional voices choose their register, and this is the register euphemism/agent-hiding is written in.
the AGENT of an agentive verb is a HIGH-relevance omission by construction -- this residual only exists because 'fire' already joined AgentiveVerb.
AGENT of an agentive verb -- HIGH relevance by construction.

a right's TO-complement is its DEFINING valency -- a competent speaker would know what right is meant; HIGH relevance (the canonical 'states' rights' euphemism case).
a killing's victim (OF) is defining -- HIGH relevance.
a killing's agent (BY) is defining -- HIGH relevance, the nominal twin of agent-deletion.
a death's subject (OF) is defining -- HIGH relevance.
who bore the casualties (AMONG) is defining -- HIGH relevance.
growth's measured domain is routinely left implicit in ordinary usage ('the economy is growing') -- LOW relevance, not a marked omission.
the alternate growth complement -- LOW relevance, same reasoning as role:growth:of.
cuts' target is often contextually obvious/optional in casual mention -- LOW relevance.
usually named nearby in practice -- LOW-moderate relevance.

effects.note: agentless passive over an agentive verb -- the responsible actor is omitted
relational noun with an absent expected complement -- the residual is the formulated question, never an answer

effects.basis: register+relevance combined >= strategic threshold (0.7) -- source signal gated (not reachable for a bare-clause residual)
effects.note: DEFEASIBLE posit: the omission plausibly does rhetorical work here -- graded and revisable, never a certainty

effects.basis: register+relevance combined <= incidental threshold (0.15) -- source signal gated (not reachable for a bare-clause residual)
effects.note: DEFEASIBLE posit: the omission looks routine/unmarked here -- graded and revisable, never a certainty

effects.basis: register+relevance combined between thresholds (0.15, 0.7) -- neither signal family is strong enough alone to commit; source signal gated (not reachable for a bare-clause residual)
effects.note: HONEST posit: signal is too thin to call this strategic OR incidental -- the agent declines to guess
